text: BrennanAG protects against a server failing. It does nothing for a bad deployment or ordinary index drift. This lesson automates the second layer of protection with the dbatools PowerShell toolkit.

Three cmdlets carry the whole job: Backup-DbaDatabase for nightly full and fifteen-minute log backups, Test-DbaLastBackup to actually prove a backup restores, and Invoke-DbaDbMaintenance to keep indexes and statistics healthy every week.
A backup file existing on disk isn't the same claim as a backup being restorable. Test-DbaLastBackup performs a real restore and a real DBCC CHECKDB, and only then reports success.
Every step runs as its own SQL Server Agent job, scheduled through dbatools itself -- four jobs, zero manual steps, running every day whether or not anyone remembers.
Backups are automated and proven restorable. Next, we chase down a real slow query the production floor has been complaining about.
